description: Guided Idea-to-Draft CLI Session - Implement a command-first guided session that produces first-draft artifacts from idea input in one run.

userStories.title: Start guided idea-to-draft session from CLI
userStories.description: As a user, I want to start a guided idea-to-draft session from CLI so that I can run a deterministic path from prompt to draft output.
acceptanceCriteria: CLI exposes a command that starts a guided idea-to-draft session
Session flow executes deterministic stages from idea input to draft generation
Command usage and required inputs are validated within the session flow
researchTopics: Existing CLI command patterns for guided workflows in this repository
Deterministic session-state transition patterns in current workflow engine

userStories.title: Persist draft output and run metadata
userStories.description: As an operator, I want draft output and execution metadata persisted for each run so that sessions are auditable and recoverable.
acceptanceCriteria: Draft artifact is persisted to configured local-first storage for each successful session run
Execution metadata includes run identifier, start/end timestamps, and session status
Persistence format is compatible with existing project evidence/logging conventions
researchTopics: Current artifact and metadata persistence conventions under .aha-loop
Local-first constraints and failure handling for write operations
userStories.notes: Depends on PRD-002 evidence contract expectations.

userStories.title: Generate E2E evidence artifact per session run
userStories.description: As a release and QA stakeholder, I want an E2E evidence artifact generated for each guided session run so that compliance evidence is consistent and reviewable.
acceptanceCriteria: Each guided session run produces an E2E evidence artifact
Evidence artifact includes references to input prompt, produced draft, and run metadata
Evidence artifact follows the evidence contract defined for session records
researchTopics: PRD-002 evidence contract schema and required fields for E2E session records
Existing tooling path for generating and validating release/quality evidence artifacts
userStories.notes: Depends on PRD-002 evidence contract for e2e session records.
